name: ov5647
description: 1/4-inch 5 Mpixel CMOS sensor, 2592x1944, 10-bit, MIPI CSI-2. The sensor on the Raspberry Pi Camera Module v1, and this project's reference camera. STUB in one respect: only the 1080p crop mode this bench runs is stated; the full-resolution and binned modes join when a bench states them.

derived_from.notes: Structural facts: array geometry, native CFA order, chip identity, the 20-bit coarse exposure register, the BLC target pedestal.

derived_from.reference: This project's bench: OV5647 module on Raspberry Pi 3B, values read back from the running part over V4L2 (2026-08-21).
derived_from.notes: The gain law is bench-verified: code 200 measured as 12.5x, confirming gain = code/16, with the code range 16..1023 read from the control limits. The exposure clamp was confirmed live: maximum 1121 lines at a frame length of 1125, the stated margin of 4. Mode timing is the part's own defaults (line 2416, frame 1104 at 87.5 MHz); runtime blanking writes stretch these (this bench runs 2593x1125 for 30.00 fps), which is a control matter, not a mode fact. apply_delay_frames is stated from ecosystem behaviour and is promoted to bench-verified when the AE work exercises the write scheduler.

provenance.notes: The Linux kernel driver drivers/media/i2c/ov5647.c is GPL-2.0. Its register tables are NOT transcribed here and must not be: that licence is incompatible with this project's. It may be consulted as a cross-reference for behaviour, and cited, but values must come from the datasheet or be read back from the running part, as above.
